dialogues.speaker: Haloa Nui
dialogues.text: Ooh, you've got a good eye.

dialogues.speaker: Haloa Nui
dialogues.text: Well, since that's the case, let me give you a helpful tip!

dialogues.speaker: Haloa Nui
dialogues.text: Go find a guy called Wakea Nui. He'll show you all the fun places in the tribe!
